result:
Wrote `index.md` with synthesis. Cover drafted by scout-illustrator (`cover.svg`, rust palette, cloche-on-plate motif over Bergamasco foothills).

Synthesis covers: (1) lodging-as-gating-constraint (La Dimora's 10 rooms scarcer than the table itself), (2) how the lodging choice rewrites the day-trip frame, (3) Trescore/Bagnatica/Albano S. Alessandro reconsidered as day-trip candidates per the parent topic's instruction, (4) the Franciacorta-vs-Lake-Iseo same-day warning, (5) the three tech-event dates worth pegging a dinner to, and (6) an honest gap call-out on dinner mechanics (tasting price, pairing cost, dress code, meal length) — these were used as constraints across children but never verified as a sub-topic. Tags span the expedition: `brusaporto, da-vittorio, bergamo, lombardy, weekend-trip`.
